enceladus.uFromLon: u = fract(0.5 + lonEastDeg/360)  (body frame: lonEast = atan2(y, x), +x = 0 deg = sub-Saturn meridian)
enceladus.vFromLat: v = 0.5 - latDeg/180  (v measured from the TOP row; flip if your texture origin is bottom-left)
enceladus.source: USGS Astrogeology "Enceladus Cassini Global Mosaic 110m" (Enceladus_Cassini_mosaic_global_110m.tif; Bland et al./CICLOPS, Cassini ISS 2004-2015; = Photojournal PIA14937 lineage)
enceladus.sourceLayout: ISIS SimpleCylindrical, CenterLongitude=180 PositiveWest, UpperLeftCornerX=0 => image centre 0 deg, 14401x7201
enceladus.license: Public domain (NASA/JPL-Caltech/Space Science Institute; USGS Astrogeology products are public domain)
enceladus.noData: 0.07% of pixels were DN 0 (no data) and were filled by smooth interpolation

iapetus.sourceLayout: equidistant cylindrical, image centre 180 deg (verified: Cassini Regio centred at x=0.75, the large trailing-side basin at x=0.27); rolled by 180 deg here
iapetus.calibration: two-point: equatorial apex (90W) mean -> normal albedo 0.04, antapex (270W) mean -> 0.55; linear in between; area-weighted mean albedo 0.307

iapetus.note: enhanced-colour source used for luminance only; the moon colour comes from MoonState.color
